name: Red Avenue New Materials Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Red Avenue New Materials Group Co., Ltd. manufactures materials for the tire, electronics, and biodegradable materials industries. The company operates through three segments: Rubber Additives for Tyres and Other Chemical Products, Electronic Materials, and Fully Biodegradable Materials. The company's Rubber Additives for Tyres and Other Chemical Products segment manufactures phenolic resins, rubber processing aids, silica and functional additives, chemical peptizers, anti-reversion agents, homogenizers, and coupling agents for carbon black.
